normalized_review.title: Misleading UC Technicians - Fraud attempts
normalized_review.text:
Misleading UC Technicians - Fraud attempts. Extremely Poor Experience – Misleading Diagnosis and Zero Customer Support

I had a very disappointing experience with Urban Company. I booked a washing machine repair service because the drum was not rotating.

When the technician visited, he claimed that a rat bite had damaged the motherboard and the water inlet pipe, and quoted ₹2,500 for the repair. I was suspicious of this diagnosis and decided not to proceed.

To get a second opinion, I contacted a local technician. He inspected the machine and fixed the issue for just ₹300. It turned out that only a few wires had been damaged, which he repaired simply by reconnecting and taping them.

The difference between the diagnosis and the actual repair is shocking. Quoting ₹2,500 for an issue that was resolved for ₹300 raises serious concerns about the technician’s honesty and technical expertise.

What made the experience even worse was Urban Company’s customer support. Despite explaining the entire incident, customer care refused to take any responsibility and declined to refund even the service fee. Their response was that they could not do anything from their end. This is completely unacceptable for a platform that claims to provide reliable and professional services.

Customers pay for the convenience and trust that Urban Company promises, but when something goes wrong, there seems to be no accountability or customer protection.

Urban Company needs to take responsibility for its technicians, investigate misleading quotations, and provide proper customer support.

My advice to other customers: Always get a second opinion before approving expensive repairs through Urban Company.

Extremely disappointing experience. I would think twice before using this platform again!

normalized_review.title: Misleading Commitments, Poor Customer Service and Lack of Accountability
normalized_review.text:
Misleading Commitments, Poor Customer Service and Lack of Accountability. I had a very disappointing experience with Urban Company regarding a kitchen cleaning service.

When I initially raised a complaint, their chatbot clearly confirmed that a free replacement service would be provided. It also mentioned that no slots were currently available. I specifically asked whether there was any time limit for availing the replacement, and the chatbot explicitly confirmed that there was no time limit.

When I contacted them again today to avail the promised service, I was connected to a customer service executive who completely contradicted the earlier communication. She stated that the information provided by the chatbot was incorrect and that they could only take feedback but would not offer any free replacement service.

What made the experience even worse was the executive’s arrogant and rude attitude. It is unacceptable for a company to provide misleading commitments through its chatbot and then refuse to honour them, leaving the customer to deal with the consequences of their incorrect information.

Extremely disappointing customer service and a complete lack of accountability. I would seriously reconsider using Urban Company again.
